message.content: {"skills": [{"category": "characterization", "trigger": "When evaluating a chest X-ray for signs of unilateral lung hypoplasia or volume loss, specifically to identify the triad of findings associated with Scimitar syndrome (hypogenetic lung syndrome).", "steps": ["Assess lung volumes by comparing the size and rib count of the right lung to the left; look for a smaller right hemithorax indicating volume loss.", "Determine the direction of the mediastinal shift; in right lung hypoplasia, the heart and mediastinum will be shifted toward the affected (right) side.", "Evaluate the position of the right hemidiaphragm; check for elevation compared to the left side.", "Synthesize findings: The combination of right lung volume loss, ipsilateral (rightward) mediastinal shift, and an elevated right hemidiaphragm characterizes the radiological features of Scimitar syndrome."]}]}
